verdict_text:
YES

The script drops blocks 2, 6, 10, 14, renumbers survivors in original order to 0..11, passes the two non-block tensors through unchanged, and writes a single `out/T1/model.safetensors`. Its assertions run before the write and cover the required checks: the surviving layer index set must equal exactly {0..11} (which rules out any block 12–15 and enforces exactly 12 blocks), and the tensor count must be 86. A failed assertion exits non-zero with nothing written.
